Fixed: findBlockByUid (used to resolve linkedBlock references during a stitch run) could resolve a linkedBlock/linkedFile wrapper node as if it were the real content it points to, if its own uid ever collided with the blockUid being searched for — silently corrupting whatever the stitch run imported. Now excludes linkedBlock/linkedFile from ever being returned as a match, matching the same guard already applied elsewhere in the app.

title: Docs: Skill Now Clarifies stitch Is Not Singleton

Fixed: The bundled skill.md now explicitly documents that stitch blocks are NOT singleton — multiple stitch runner blocks per file (e.g. for separate test suites) is intentional. Previously unstated, which risked an AI agent incorrectly removing a valid second stitch block.

Added: The Stitch Runner block now shows an inline "?" help tooltip in its header, matching the other request blocks
An "Open Documentation" item now appears in the Stitch Runner block's right-click block menu, opening the Voiden Blocks docs in your system browser

Improved: AI skill documentation updated with missing stitch block attrs (uid, parallelRun, globalVariables, scenarioVariables) and Excel export capability

Added: Parallel run mode: toggle the new 'Run mode' option in the stitch block to switch between sequential and parallel — files fire concurrently via Promise.allSettled so one failure never blocks others

Inherited config support: .voiden-inherited ancestor files are now automatically resolved and applied per file during a stitch run, matching the same inheritance chain behaviour as normal .void execution (closest ancestor wins, child blocks always override)
Fixed: Parallel toggle had no effect because the 'parallel' flag was missing from the handleRun useCallback dependency array — the stale closure always passed parallel: false to the engine regardless of what the UI showed

Added: Scenario variables: define key-value pairs per scenario to substitute {{VAR}} references in URLs, headers, body, query params, and path params at run time
File-type scenario variables: mark a variable as 'file' to pick a project-relative file path via native browser — used for binary uploads and multipart form fields
File path variables are stored relative to the project root so stitch configs are portable across machines
Scenario variables are substituted in binary (restFile) and multipart body_params so different files can be uploaded per scenario without editing the .void file
Results panel now shows a scenario vars pill on each file row — click to expand and inspect the exact key=value pairs used for that run
Drag-to-reorder execution order: expand the matched files list and drag any file using the grip handle to set a custom run sequence
Custom order is persisted in the stitch block — files listed in the saved order run first, remaining matched files append alphabetically
Reset button restores alphabetical ordering when a custom order is set
Fixed: Newly added scenarios were not picked up when running the stitch — handleRun now re-captures scenario state reactively so changes are reflected immediately without re-opening the block
Empty .void files no longer trigger a misleading 'Could not read file' error — they now report 'File is empty (no requests)' and are recorded as skipped
File discovery count in the Stitch block now refreshes automatically when files are added or removed from the project folder
4xx and 5xx HTTP responses now correctly marked as failed at both file and section level
Section-level status dot and pass/fail badge now reflect HTTP error status
getSchema bundled correctly — stitch runner no longer crashes on execute
Linked block resolution no longer fails when a referenced file is renamed
Removed catch-all shim for correct dependency bundling

Added: Chain requests: pass response values from one request into the next
JSONPath extractor for chained variable binding
Improved: Stitch block UI with clearer connection indicators
